title: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City: show, tickets, getting there
description: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City: the Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca show, show days, seat classes and prices, child height rules, no-refund policy and how to get there.
h1: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City: what the show is, what tickets cost and how to get there
intro: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City is on the third floor of Vincom Mega Mall Ocean City, east of Hanoi. It stages one 75-minute show, Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca (The Grand Epic of Vietnam), Thursday to Sunday at 19:30. The show opened on 10 July 2026. Ticket prices depend on the seat class and on whether you go on a weekday or at the weekend. Children under 1 metre tall cannot get in, and tickets cannot be refunded.
keyPoints: The show is **Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca**, in English **The Grand Epic of Vietnam**. It runs from 19:30 to 20:45, Thursday to Sunday, with no interval, according to the theatre's official site as of November 2026.
The theatre has five seat classes. Adult tickets on the official site run from {{vnd:400000}} on Thursday and Friday up to {{vnd:1200000}} for the best seats at the weekend. Child tickets cost half.
Children **under 1 metre** cannot get in. Children from 1 to 1.4 metres pay the child price, and anyone 1.4 metres or taller pays the adult price.
Tickets **cannot be changed or refunded**, and the doors close 15 minutes after the show starts. Arrive at least 30 minutes early.
The 50% discount for students, people aged 60 and over and veterans ran only from 10 July to 31 August 2026. Don't expect it now.

sections.title: What is Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?

blocks.text: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City is a purpose-built theatre inside **Vincom Mega Mall Ocean City**. The mall is in the Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 development on the far side of the Red River from central Hanoi. The theatre puts on one show: **Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca**, which VinWonders' English pages call **The Grand Epic of Vietnam**. According to [the theatre's official site](https://vinpearl-theatre.vinwonders.com/), the show's first performance was on 10 July 2026.

VinWonders' audience guide gives the address as Level 3, Vincom Mega Mall, Vinhomes Ocean Park 2, Văn Giang, Hưng Yên. Ocean City sits just across the provincial border from Hanoi, which is why the address says Hưng Yên rather than Hanoi. [Dân Trí reported](https://dantri.com.vn/doi-song/vingroup-tang-50-gia-ve-show-dat-nuoc-thien-hung-ca-20260730151758217.htm) that Vingroup invested in the production and that Vinpearl's chief executive presented it. Tickets are sold through VinWonders, Vingroup's attractions brand.
What is the show about?

The show tells about 4,000 years of Vietnamese history in six chapters, according to [the theatre's official site](https://vinpearl-theatre.vinwonders.com/) as of November 2026. The same site says more than 100 artists and actors take part, and that the production has 12 stage effects and 8 "WOW Moments". Dân Trí reported that the show uses stage effects seen in Vietnam for the first time, but it did not describe them.

blocks.title: Not in Ho Chi Minh City
blocks.text: Ocean City is near Hanoi, at the other end of the country from Saigon. If you live in Ho Chi Minh City, this is not an evening out from home: the show is in the Hanoi area.

sections.title: When does the show run, and how long is it?

blocks.text: The show runs **Thursday to Sunday every week, from 19:30 to 20:45**, according to [the theatre's official site](https://vinpearl-theatre.vinwonders.com/) as of November 2026. There are no shows from Monday to Wednesday. The show lasts about 75 minutes with no interval. [VinWonders' audience guide](https://vinwonders.com/vi/wonderpedia/news/cam-nang-thong-tin-danh-cho-khan-gia-dat-nuoc-thien-hung-ca/) says that if you have to step out, staff will bring you back in at a suitable moment.

The official site and the audience guide both say 19:30, and the audience guide advises checking official channels or the ticketing system for any change. Check the time on your ticket for the date you book. The audience guide also says the show has Vietnamese subtitles. Neither page mentions English subtitles or translation, so the story comes mostly through music, staging and effects.

sections.title: How much are Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City tickets?

blocks.text: The price depends on the seat class and the day. Adult tickets run from {{vnd:400000}} (Non Sông Gấm Vóc, Thursday or Friday) to {{vnd:1200000}} (Lạc Hồng, Saturday or Sunday), according to [the theatre's official site](https://vinpearl-theatre.vinwonders.com/) as of November 2026. Child tickets cost half the adult price.

The site lists a Monday-to-Friday price and a Saturday-and-Sunday price. The show only runs from Thursday, so the lower price applies on **Thursday and Friday**. For a given seat, Thursday or Friday saves you {{vnd:200000}} per adult ticket compared with the weekend.

blocks.caption: Ticket prices by seat class, from vinpearl-theatre.vinwonders.com as read on 24 November 2026

blocks.text: Are there discounts for students or over-60s?

There is no general discount running now. According to Dân Trí's July 2026 report, Vingroup offered 50% off for veterans, people aged 60 and over and students from 10 July to 31 August 2026, with a limited number of discounted seats per show. That offer has ended. The official site also mentions combo packages that pair the show with Grand World, the gondola, Aquafield and dining, for up to 30% off. If you also want those attractions, check the combos when you book.
Who needs a child ticket?

Ticket type depends on height, not age. The show does not sell tickets for children under 1 metre, so they cannot get in. VinWonders' audience guide puts the child band below 1.4 metres and the adult price from 1.4 metres.

sections.title: How do I book tickets for the show?

blocks.text: Book online in advance. Dân Trí reported that tickets could also be bought at the theatre's box office. According to VinWonders' audience guide, the e-ticket comes as a **QR code by email or phone message**. One order can hold up to 20 people. Students, seniors and people with recognised revolutionary service must bring proof if they book a ticket type that requires it.

items.title: Pick a Thursday or Friday if you can
items.text: Prices are lower on those two days. Dân Trí reported that nearly all July 2026 shows were close to selling out, so book early.

items.title: Choose the seat class
items.text: Use the table above. Wheelchair users can only sit in row A, the front row, according to the official site, so book that row specifically.

items.title: Check each child's height
items.text: Under 1 metre cannot go in. From 1 to 1.4 metres is a child ticket, and 1.4 metres or taller is an adult ticket.

items.title: Buy and keep the QR code safe
items.text: Each QR code lets one person in once, according to the official site, so don't share it.

items.title: Arrive 30–45 minutes early
items.text: You need that time to park, have your ticket checked and find your seat. The doors close 15 minutes after the show starts.

blocks.text: If you would rather start from one page, eno.vn's [tickets, travel and eSIM category](/c/tickets-travel) lists VinWonders attractions, including Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City. VinWonders is an official eno.vn partner. On 24 November 2026, the Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City listing there showed prices from {{vnd:480000}} for the lowest adult ticket, with the final price set at checkout by date. Check the price and seat class on the booking page before you pay. The same category also lists other things in Ocean City, such as Grand World, the wave and water park, and Aquafield.

blocks.title: No refunds, no date changes
blocks.text: According to the official site, tickets cannot be refunded, cancelled or exchanged for cash or other services, apart from force majeure or where the organiser's policy says otherwise. Be sure of the date and the number of people before you pay.

sections.title: How do I get to Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?

blocks.text: The theatre is at the back of Vincom Mega Mall Ocean City, with its entrance on Level 3. According to [VinWonders' travel guide](https://vinwonders.com/en/wonderpedia/news/how-to-get-to-grand-epic-vietnam/) (read November 2026), getting there takes about 30–45 minutes from central Hanoi. Once you are at the mall's bus stop or car park, it is a 3–5 minute walk.

blocks.text: How do I get back after the show?

The show ends at 20:45. Check the time of the last VinBus back in the VinBus app before you leave, because VinWonders does not publish return times on its pages. If the last bus is too early, a Green SM ride is the simple option. If you are visiting from another city and need mobile data for the apps, see our [eSIM guide for Vietnam](/esim-vietnam-guide).

sections.title: What are the rules inside the theatre?

blocks.text: You cannot film, photograph, record or livestream during the show, and you cannot bring outside food or drink into the auditorium. These rules come from the official site and VinWonders' audience guide. Flash is not allowed, and phones should be on silent or vibrate.

items: **Your seat**: sit in the seat printed on your ticket.
**Late arrival**: the doors close 15 minutes after the start, and a ticket cannot be refunded or moved to another night.
**Moving during the show**: try not to go in and out. If you must, staff will bring you back in at a suitable moment.

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: **Other Vinpearl shows**, such as the Tata Show at VinWonders Nha Trang. That is a different show at a different venue. Check VinWonders' own pages for it.
**Exact seat maps and which rows each class covers.** The official site does not publish them. You will see them when you pick seats during booking.
**Flights and hotels** from Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi. Book those separately.
**English translation of the show.** VinWonders mentions only Vietnamese subtitles. Ask the theatre's hotline, listed on its official site, if you need anything else.

faqs.q: What show is on at Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?
faqs.a: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City stages Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca, called The Grand Epic of Vietnam in English. It is a 75-minute show about some 4,000 years of Vietnamese history, told in six chapters by more than 100 artists and actors, with 12 stage effects. According to the theatre's official site, the show opened on 10 July 2026 and runs Thursday to Sunday from 19:30 to 20:45.

faqs.q: Where is Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?
faqs.a: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City is on Level 3 at the back of Vincom Mega Mall Ocean City, in Vinhomes Ocean Park 2. Its address is in Hưng Yên province, just across the border from Hanoi. According to VinWonders, the drive from central Hanoi takes about 30 to 45 minutes. VinBus routes OCT1 and OCT2 run from Royal City, Times City and Hoan Kiem Lake to the mall.

faqs.q: How much are tickets for Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca?
faqs.a: Tickets for Đất Nước Thiên Hùng Ca at Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City are priced by five seat classes, from Non Sông Gấm Vóc up to Lạc Hồng. The Thursday and Friday price is lower than the Saturday and Sunday price, and child tickets cost half the adult price. The full price table from the official site, as read in November 2026, is in the ticket section of this guide.

faqs.q: Can children watch the show at Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?
faqs.a: Children can watch the show at Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City if they are at least 1 metre tall. The theatre sells no tickets for children under 1 metre. Children from 1 to 1.4 metres pay the child price, which is half the adult price, and anyone 1.4 metres or taller pays the adult price. Check every child's height before booking, because tickets cannot be refunded.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund on Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City tickets?
faqs.a: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City tickets cannot be refunded, cancelled or exchanged for cash or other services, according to the theatre's official site. The only exceptions are force majeure or cases the organiser's policy allows. The doors close 15 minutes after the 19:30 start, so arriving late can mean losing the ticket. Check the date and the number of people carefully before paying.

faqs.q: Which days are cheapest for Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?
faqs.a: Thursday and Friday are the cheapest days for Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City. The official site lists a lower Monday-to-Friday price and a higher Saturday-and-Sunday price, and the show only runs from Thursday to Sunday. For every seat class, a Thursday or Friday adult ticket costs less than the same seat at the weekend. Dân Trí reported that nearly all July 2026 shows were close to selling out.

faqs.q: Is there a student or senior discount at Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City?
faqs.a: Vinpearl Theatre Ocean City had a 50% discount for students, people aged 60 and over and veterans, but only from 10 July to 31 August 2026, according to Dân Trí. That offer has ended. Combo packages that pair the show with Grand World, the gondola or Aquafield can still save up to 30%. Anyone booking a concession ticket type must bring proof of eligibility.
